fields.description: Which Proxmox Server.role segment this report covers — reports are generated separately per role (Production, Development, Staging, ...) rather than blended into one, so a Production issue is never buried under Development noise. "Unassigned" covers any enabled server with no role set. Not applicable to Host Health reports (blank).
fields.label: Role

fields.description: Start of the 7-day window this report analyzed.
fields.label: Period Start

fields.description: The Bifrost model used to generate this report — informational only; actual cost/tokens are tracked in LLM Usage Log once Bifrost's own sync cycle picks up this call.
fields.label: Model Used

fields.description: One-line takeaway — the only content that goes into the WhatsApp message (Meta template body variable), and shown in the dashboard's report list without opening the full report.
fields.label: Summary

fields.description: Full itemized report (Markdown) — sections differ by report_type (Proxmox Fleet: Executive Summary, Right-Sizing Suggestions, Recurring Issues, Action Items; Host Health: Executive Summary, Recurring Errors & Recommended Fixes, Action Items). Sent verbatim as the email body and rendered in the dashboard's report detail view.
fields.label: Report
